policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. Update measured counts in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances; never lower a floor without an explicit, justified scope change.

tolerance.rationale: The rebased branch combines the server-owned ARR download lifecycle regressions with the actor-isolated admin-target Canopy User Settings editor. The admin-target tests exercise one additional existing core line without changing the 2666-line client/core scope, advancing the reviewed high-water from 2325/2666 (87.209%) to 2326/2666 (87.247%). Two clean combined Node 22.20/V8 runs on 2026-07-26 each passed all 1603 tests across 227 files and reproduced exactly 2326/2666. Retaining the one-line tolerance makes the minimum 2325/2666 (87.209%), equal to the prior reviewed high-water and stricter than its 2324/2666 tolerated floor (87.172%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The Maintainerr v3.18 integration adds 1,699 instrumented lines over the reviewed pre-integration server baseline (31,176→32,875) for its closed read-only transport allowlist, private-target and connect-time rebinding guards, caller-scoped projections, strict DTO parsing, byte/array/pagination bounds, generation-owned cache and single-flight behavior, explicit error taxonomy, and bounded 4-active/12-waiting admission policy. Its controller, transport, authorization, privacy, cancellation, cache, schema, concurrency, endpoint, and collection-consistency regressions add 1,502 covered lines at the reviewed high-water (22,637→24,139), raising coverage from 72.610% to 73.427%. Three clean .NET 10.0.9/Coverlet runs on 2026-07-26 each passed all 2,179 tests and reproduced exactly the 32,875-line scope; Coverlet reported a narrow 24,136–24,139 covered-line instrumentation range (24,136 twice and 24,139 once). Recording the reviewed high-water and retaining the evidence-bounded five-line tolerance makes the minimum 24,134/32,875 (73.412%), includes every observed clean measurement, and remains stricter than both the prior 24,115/32,858 high-water (73.392%) and its 24,110/32,858 tolerated floor (73.376%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
